entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Before you stands a creature about as tall as a Halfling, covered in small white fur and with a disproportionate head.
You also notice he does not wield his greatsword. It seems to float in the air, bound to his will.*#WHITE#
Why did you save me, stranger? You are not of the Way.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*在你面前站着一个和半身人一样高的生物，身披细密的白色绒毛，脑袋与身体大小不协调。
你同时注意到他并没有用手握持大剑，剑正漂浮在空中，仿佛受他的意志控制。*#WHITE#
你为什么救我，陌生人？你不属于维网。

entries.source: How fares your research? Are we ready to create the portal?
entries.target: 你研究的怎么样了？我们可以创造传送门了么？

entries.source:
The keepers of ar... err, I do not think I am supposed to talk about them... sorry, my friend...
In any case, I must collect many items. I have some already but I am still looking for an arcane-infused artefact. You do not happen to have one, I imagine... Well, if you do, tell me please!
entries.target:
他们守护着奥……呃，我好像不该谈论他们……抱歉，我的朋友……
无论如何，我必须收集许多物品。我已经有了一些，但还在寻找一件充满奥术能量的神器。我想你不会碰巧有一件吧……嗯，要是你有，请一定告诉我！

entries.source: You may only dream walk to an open space within your line of sight.
entries.target: 你只能梦境穿梭至视野内的空地。

entries.source:
Your weapon attacks burn with righteous fury, dealing %d%% of your lost HP as additional Fire damage (up to %d, Current:  %d).
		Targets struck are also afflicted with a Martyrdom effect that causes them to take %d%% of all damage they deal for 4 turns.
		The bonus damage can only occur once per turn.
entries.target:
你使用武器攻击时，造成相当于 %d%% 你已损失的生命值的火焰伤害，至多 %d 点，当前 %d 点
		然后令目标进入殉难状态，受到 %d%% 自己造成的伤害，持续 4 回合。
		每回合最多触发一次额外伤害。

entries.source: A cloak can simply keep you warm or grant you wondrous powers should you find a magical one.
entries.target: 斗篷可以让你保持温暖，而一些魔法斗篷可以给你神奇的力量。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the Old Forest and vanquished Shardskin.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你已经探索了古老森林并杀死了水晶树精。#WHITE#

entries.source: The target takes cover in its shell, gaining %d%% all resist.
entries.target: 目标被甲壳覆盖，全体伤害抗性增加%d%%。

entries.source: The target is disabled, reducing movement speed by %d%% and accuracy by %d.
entries.target: 目标陷入瘫痪，移动速度降低 %d%%，命中降低 %d。

entries.source: Wait. I am not ready yet.
Renders a random talent unavailable. Talent cooldown is halved until the effect has worn off.
entries.target: 随机使一个技能无法使用。该状态下所有技能冷却速度减半。

entries.source: You should bring it to the elders of Last Hope in the southeast.
entries.target: 你应该把它带给位于东南方的最后的希望长老们。

entries.source: The target is losing one sustain per turn.
entries.target: 每回合失去一项维持技能。

entries.source:
You have learned how to carefully manage contact between you and your opponent.
		When striking in melee with your dual wielded weapons, you automatically avoid up to %d damage dealt to you from each of your target's on hit effects.  This improves with your Dexterity, but is not possible with mindstars.
		In addition, while this talent is active, you redirect %d%% of the damage you avoid this way back to your target.
entries.target:
你已学会谨慎掌控自己与对手之间的接触。
		用双持武器进行近战攻击时，你会自动减免目标每次命中效果对你造成的至多 %d 点伤害。该减伤随敏捷提高，但使用灵晶时无法触发。
		此外，该技能开启时，你会将以此方式减免伤害的 %d%% 反弹给目标。

entries.source: The entry to the old tower of Dreadfell

This area appears to have been hit by a huge tremor, breaking the floor in a huge crack.
You think you can jump to the level below.
entries.target:
这块区域似乎经历过巨大的震动，将地板砸出了一个大洞。
你觉得你可以跳进下面的楼层。

entries.source:
A gaunt vaguely humanoid shape featuring unadorned grey leathery skin. Its arms and legs seem somehow too long and it stands tall, projecting an ominous shadow even in darkness.
Its glowing red eyes shine with both cruelty and a deep frightening intellect.
entries.target:
一个憔悴而模糊不清的人形生物，全身是未经修饰的灰色皮肤。不知为何，它的胳膊和腿很长。当它耸立在那里的时候，即使在黑暗中也会投下不祥的阴影。
它发光的红色眼睛闪烁着，目光里蕴含着既残酷又深邃可怕的智慧。

entries.source: Can you tell me more about the Way?
entries.target: 你能告诉我更多有关维网的事么？

entries.source:
#{bold}#3800: #{normal}#Gold accepted as standard unit of currency amongst all races after heavy lobbying. This is greatly to our favour, as our vein resources are high and the material otherwise has no practical usage. Must continue to stockpile more.
#{bold}#4200: #{normal}#New smelting techniques developed allow more stralite to be recovered from existing veins. Techniques must be kept hidden from other races.
#{bold}#4362: #{normal}#Grand Smith Dakhtun has discovered new methods of infusing magical effects in weapons and armour. Potential for profit growth in this area very high.
#{bold}#4550: #{normal}#First special meeting of Iron Throne Profits Committee. War with humans and halflings worrying, as it is reducing potential market size. Threat of complete market elimination forces us to drastic action - all weapons trade must cease. Increase stockpiles of construction materials in hope of eventual reconciliation.
#{bold}#5967: #{normal}#Shaloren involvement in war is becoming too grave a risk - legends of Sher'Tul destruction are a pertinent reminder of the dangers of high magic. Increasing investment in new Ziguranth order in hopes of opposing this problem.
#{bold}#6550: #{normal}#War ended. Opportunity presents itself - now reopening trade, with high prices on all construction items. Profits forecast is very high.
#{bold}#6827: #{normal}#Killed Kroltar the Crimson Wyrm and recovered his hoard. Value of hoard: 20 million gold. Resources lost in recovery effort: 7 million gold (estimation based on standard assessment of 350 gold per capita lost). Net profit: 13 million gold. Profit margin is 186%!
#{bold}#6980: #{normal}#Resources based on dragon hoards are dwindling. Must reduce cull targets to allow recovery of numbers.
#{bold}#7420: #{normal}#Major orc attacks are ruining trade arrangements. Cutting off all contracts until markets settle.
#{bold}#7494: #{normal}#Disastrous use of magic by Shaloren elves has had an unprecedented impact on profitability of our operations. Increasing protectionist measures to prevent economic ruin.
entries.target:
#{bold}#3800：#{normal}#经大力游说，黄金被所有种族接受为标准货币单位。这对我们极为有利，因为我们的金矿脉资源丰富，而这种材料除此之外并无实际用途。必须继续增加储备。
#{bold}#4200：#{normal}#新开发的冶炼技术可以从现有矿脉中提取更多斯莱特。必须对其他种族隐瞒这些技术。
#{bold}#4362：#{normal}#大工匠达克顿发现了为武器和护甲注入魔法效果的新方法。该领域的利润增长潜力极高。
#{bold}#4550：#{normal}#钢铁王座利润委员会首次召开特别会议。与人类和半身人的战争令人担忧，因为潜在市场规模正在缩小。市场可能彻底消失，迫使我们采取激烈行动——必须停止一切武器贸易。增加建筑材料储备，以待最终和解。
#{bold}#5967：#{normal}#永恒精灵参战正成为过于严重的风险——夏·图尔造成毁灭的传说恰好提醒我们高等魔法有多么危险。加大对新兴伊格兰斯教团的投资，希望借此对抗这一问题。
#{bold}#6550：#{normal}#战争结束。机会已经出现——立即重开贸易，并为所有建筑材料索取高价。预计利润极高。
#{bold}#6827：#{normal}#杀死了赤红巨龙库洛塔并夺得了他的财宝。财宝价值：两千万金。回收行动损失资源七百万金（按每名损失人员 350 金的标准估算）。净利润：一千三百万金。利润率为 186%！
#{bold}#6980：#{normal}#以巨龙宝藏为来源的资源正在减少。必须下调猎杀指标，让巨龙数量得以恢复。
#{bold}#7420：#{normal}#兽人的大规模袭击正在破坏贸易安排。在市场稳定之前中止所有合约。
#{bold}#7494：#{normal}#永恒精灵灾难性地运用魔法，对我们各项经营活动的盈利能力造成了前所未有的冲击。加强保护主义措施，防止经济崩溃。

entries.source: You can wear helmets or crowns on your head.
entries.target: 你可以在头上戴头盔或王冠。

entries.source: A collection of thoughts and memories of the archmage Varil, during the Age of Dusk.
entries.target: 黄昏纪中大法师沃利尔的想法和记忆。
掉落随机神器（自动数据）

entries.source: The evilness of undeath radiates from this amulet.
entries.target: 这件护符散发着不死生物的邪恶气息。

entries.source: Badly off guard. Attackers gain a 10% bonus to physical critical strike chance and physical critcal strike power.
entries.target: 目标失去防备，攻击者获得 10%额外物理暴击概率和暴击加成。

entries.source:
You expend massive amounts of energy to launch yourself across %d squares at incredible speed. All enemies in your path will be knocked flying and dealt between %d and %d Physical damage.
		At talent level 5, you can batter through solid walls.
entries.target:
冲锋 %d 码。
		路径上的敌人会被击退并受到 %d 至 %d 点物理伤害。
		技能等级 5 时你能冲过墙壁。

entries.source:
#{bold}#
Gygax the Great
#{normal}#38 - 108#{italic}#
Most blessed are we
To have shared this world with thee
#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#
伟大的盖加克斯
#{normal}#38 - 108#{italic}#
我们所接受的最大祝福
就是曾与你分享这个世界
#{normal}#

entries.source: The target is cursed, reducing all damage done by %d%%.
entries.target: 目标被诅咒，造成的所有伤害降低 %d%%。

entries.source:
A bulging rotten robe seems to tear at the seams, with masses of bloated worms spilling out all around the moving form.  Two arm-like appendages, each made up of overlapping mucous-drenched maggots, grasp tightly around the handles of bile-coated waraxes.
Each swing drips pustulant fluid before it, and each droplet writhes and wriggles in the air before splashing against the ground.
entries.target: 一件鼓鼓囊囊的腐烂长袍，长袍的缝隙里不断蠕动着浮肿的蠕虫。它有着两只臂膀一样的附属物，每只都由沾满黏液的蛆重叠而成，各握着一柄覆有胆汁的斧子。每一次挥舞都会向前溅出脓液，每一滴脓液在空中扭动翻滚，然后啪嗒一声落在地上。
